definitions: A graphical user interface element, typically consisting of three horizontal lines stacked vertically, used to represent a menu or navigation options, especially on mobile devices or websites.
A common symbol in digital interfaces that, when tapped or clicked, reveals a hidden menu.
examples: Click the three bars icon to open the main menu.
The three bars icon is often called a 'hamburger menu'.
Look for the three bars icon in the top corner of the screen.
